text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe claimed victory in the 
decisive Arima Kinen. However, her races 
will continue on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run through today together 
alongside Agnes Tachyon, there is no doubt 
they will continue to compete against each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "friend" Manhattan Cafe spoke of was 
an entity that evolved as her standards 
grew higher—something very close to the 
ideal figure she envisioned for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe said that, because her 
Trainer had elevated her, her "friend" had 
grown even faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe and her Trainer firmly 
promised each other that they would 
continue to pursue their ideal together 
from here on out.
